d: Alphabet, Google’s parent company, lost about $500 billion in market value in a single day after investors reacted to growing concerns over artificial intelligence. Google’s AI Mode is changing how people search by giving users direct answers instead of pushing them towards traditional search results and ads. Google reported quarterly revenue of more than $127 billion, up 25% year-on-year, but profits fell by roughly the same percentage.
